## The event

FreightTech Europe 2025, Rotterdam Ahoy, 5 and 6 November. CFP closes 15 July 23:59 CET. Talks are 25 min + 5 Q&A. Submission ref after sending: FTE25-0417.

## Working title

"Nobody likes waiting at door 14: what 22 dock doors in Berlin taught us about scheduling"

Backup title if they want something duller: "Slot booking for warehouses, a pilot in numbers".

## Abstract (240 words, limit 250)

Trucks queue at warehouse gates across Europe for an average of almost an hour. At one Berlin site we measured 47 minutes per truck, 160 trucks a day, and a gate office taking 230 phone calls daily. We built a slot booking tool with the warehouse team, carriers and the works council, and went live in August 2025. Waiting dropped to 26 minutes. It did not drop to 20, which was our target, and this talk is partly about why. We'll cover the interviews that shaped the product, the bug that put two trucks at one door, how we got 31 carriers to book in the first week, and what we'd do differently...

(full text in the CFP form, copy saved in Drive)
